allyofjusticecosmicgateway.name: Ally of Justice Cosmic Gateway
allyofjusticecosmicgateway.desc: If your opponent controls 2 or more monsters, including a LIGHT monster, you can Special Summon this card from your hand.

ancientgeardragon.name: Ancient Gear Dragon
ancientgeardragon.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are EARTH Machine monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or effect (Quick Effect): You can send to the GY, 1 Machine monster from your hand or face-up field, or 1 "Ancient Gear Golem" from your Deck; negate that effect. You can only use this effect of "Ancient Gear Dragon" once per turn.

bravofighterfurhire.name: Bravo, Fighter Fur Hire
bravofighterfurhire.desc: During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 monster "Fur Hire" from your hand, except "Bravo, Fighter Fur Hire". If a monster "Fur Hire" is Special Summoned to your field while you control this monster (except during the Damage Step): You can have all monsters "Fur Hire" currently on the field gain 500 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Bravo, Fighter Fur Hire" once per turn.

bujinmikazuchi.name: Bujin Mikazuchi
bujinmikazuchi.desc: When a Beast-Warrior-Type "Bujin" monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or by card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if a "Bujin" monster(s) was sent from your hand to your Graveyard this turn while you controlled this face-up card: You can add 1 "Bujin" Spell/Trap Card from your Deck to your hand. You can only control 1 "Bujin Mikazuchi".

catapultzone.name: Catapult Zone
catapultzone.desc: Once per turn, if a monster you control would be destroyed by battle, you can send 1 Rock-Type monster from your Deck to the Graveyard instead.

destinedduel.name: Destined Duel
destinedduel.desc: When this card is activated: Each player can Special Summon 1 monster from their hand in Attack Position, then if there are any other face-up monsters on the field, change all of them to face-down Defense Position. For the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Normal or Special Summon. Once per turn, when your monster declares an attack: You can negate the attack, and if you do, destroy 1 face-down card your opponent controls. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: Return this card to the hand.

geartown.name: Geartown
geartown.desc: Both players can Normal Summon "Ancient Gear" monsters for 1 less Tribute. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Ancient Gear" monster from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard.

gigastoneomega.name: Gigastone Omega
gigastoneomega.desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 2 EARTH monsters from your Graveyard. When this face-up card you control is sent to the Graveyard by a card effect, destroy all Spell and Trap Cards your opponent controls.

leowizardthedarkfiend.name: Leo Wizard the Dark Fiend
leowizardthedarkfiend.desc: For a player to Normal Summon a monster from their hand with more than 1350 ATK or DEF and an original Level of 4 or lower, they must Tribute Summon it by Tributing 1 monster. At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles a LIGHT monster: You can destroy that monster. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can add 1 monster with 1350 ATK from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Leo Wizard the Dark Fiend" once per turn.

linkturret.name: Link Turret
linkturret.desc: When this card is activated: Place 4 counters on this card. Each time you take battle damage, place 1 counter on this card. During your Main Phase 2: You can remove 1 counter from this card, then target 1 "Rokket" monster in your GY; Special Summon it, but its effects are negated, also it is banished when it leaves the field. You cannot Special Summon monsters from your Extra Deck, except DARK Link Monsters, the turn you activate this effect (even if this card leaves the field).

necrosynchron.name: Necro Synchron
necrosynchron.desc: This card's name becomes "Fleur Synchron" while on the field or in the GY. You can only use each of the following effects of "Necro Synchron" once per turn. You can target 1 other face-up monster you control; increase its Level by 2 until the end of this turn. If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material for a WIND monster: You can Special Summon 1 Level 1 Plant monster from your Deck.

nettles.name: Nettles
nettles.desc: If this face-up card would be destroyed, you can destroy 1 face-up Plant-Type monster you control instead.

performageplushfire.name: Performage Plushfire
performageplushfire.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
If a "Performage" monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can Special Summon this card from your Pendulum Zone, then take 500 damage. You can only use this effect of "Performage Plushfire" once per turn.

[ Monster Effect ] 
If this card on the field is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Performage" monster from your hand or Deck, except "Performage Plushfire".

secretsixsamuraidoji.name: Secret Six Samurai - Doji
secretsixsamuraidoji.desc: When another "Six Samurai" monster is Normal or Special Summoned to your field (except during the Damage Step): You can send 1 "Six Samurai" card from your Deck to the GY. If exactly 1 "Six Samurai" monster you control (and no other cards) would be destroyed by card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead.

smashinghorn.name: Smashing Horn
smashinghorn.desc: When a monster effect or Trap Card is activated that negates the Normal or Special Summon of a monster(s): Negate the activation and destroy it.

sunlightunicorn.name: Sunlight Unicorn
sunlightunicorn.desc: Once per turn: You can excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is an Equip Spell Card, add it to your hand. Otherwise, place it on the bottom of your Deck.

torpedofish.name: Torpedo Fish
torpedofish.desc: While "Umi" is face-up on the field, this card is unaffected by any Spell Cards.

ultimateinsectlv7.name: Ultimate Insect LV7
ultimateinsectlv7.desc: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Ultimate Insect LV5", while it remains on the field all your opponent's monsters lose 700 ATK and DEF.

urubonustheavatarofmalice.name: Urubonus, the Avatar of Malice
urubonustheavatarofmalice.desc: Monsters your opponent controls lose 300 ATK/DEF. You can only use each of the following effects of "Urubonus, the Avatar of Malice" once per turn. You can Tribute 1 Reptile monster; Special Summon this card from your hand. You can Tribute 1 monster; all monsters your opponent currently controls lose ATK/DEF equal to the original ATK of the Tributed monster, until the end of this turn.

veilofdarkness.name: Veil of Darkness
veilofdarkness.desc: During your Draw Phase, if you draw a DARK monster(s): You can reveal any number of them; send them to the GY, then you can draw 1 more card.

windupwarrior.name: Wind-Up Warrior
windupwarrior.desc: You can target 1 face-up "Wind-Up" monster you control; increase its Level by 1 and its ATK by 600, until the End Phase. This effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field.
